what: Real program lists (2025-2026) of proposed intersection safety projects, for testing nml portfolio. Collected 2026-11-03 before any was run.
notes: No source stated a per-project cost, so every cost_usd is null. DC items come from separate DDOT Notices of Intent; each has its own source_page and source_says joins the NOI title and a sentence from the NOI letter with ' | '. SF source_says joins the page's treatment sentences and the location line with ' | '. Seattle items marked expected in 2026 on a page updated September 2026; some may since be built.

programs.title: NYC DOT 2025 Projects presented to community boards (single-intersection items)

projects.text: Install a new traffic signal with pedestrian-priority phasing and concrete curb extensions at E 170th St & Teller Ave (Bronx).
projects.source_says: NYC DOT proposed pedestrian safety improvements at the intersection of East 170th Street and Teller Avenue in the Bronx. The proposal included a new traffic signal with signal phasing that prioritizes pedestrians, updated markings, improved traffic control signage and concrete curb extensions to slow turning vehicle speeds and install new safer, shorter pedestrian crossings.

projects.text: Install concrete pedestrian refuge islands and new markings at Broadway & Gates Ave (Brooklyn).
projects.source_says: NYC DOT proposed Vision Zero safety improvements on Broadway in Brooklyn at the intersections of Gates Avenue and Park Avenue. The proposed improvements included installing concrete pedestrian refuge islands, new markings, and improved roadway organization.

projects.text: Install painted curb extensions at 3rd Ave & 65th St (Brooklyn, school safety).
projects.source_says: NYC DOT proposed safety upgrades at the intersection of 3rd Avenue and 65th Street and on 65th Street between 2nd and 3rd Avenues in Brooklyn, in the direct vicinity of MS 936, PS 503, PS 506, PS 971, Tom Joyce Soccer Field, John Allen Payne Playground, and Leif Ericson Park. Planned safety improvements included painted curb extensions, reconfigured travel lanes on southbound 3rd Avenue between 63th and 65th Streets to reduce speeding and organize traffic, and a stop-controlled crosswalk to provide safe pedestrian access to Tom Joyce Soccer Field.

projects.text: Install concrete pedestrian islands, clarified lane markings and new ADA ramps at Lenox Ave & W 145th St (Manhattan).
projects.source_says: NYC DOT proposed intersection safety improvements at Lenox Avenue and West 145th Street in Manhattan. The proposed improvements consisted of concrete pedestrian islands, clarified lane markings, and construction of new ADA pedestrian ramps.

projects.text: Install a concrete pedestrian island on the west leg of 31st Rd & Union St (Flushing, Queens).
projects.source_says: NYC DOT proposed intersection safety improvements at the intersection of 31st Road and Union Street in Flushing. The proposed improvements included a concrete pedestrian island on the west leg of the intersection and clarified lane markings on 31st Road.

projects.text: Install two bus boarding islands and painted pedestrian space at 31st St & 37th Ave (Queens).
projects.source_says: NYC DOT proposed bus and pedestrian safety improvements at the intersection of 31st Street and 37th Avenue in Queens. The proposed improvements included two new bus boarding islands and painted pedestrian space under the elevated subway tracks on 31st Street.

projects.text: Install painted and concrete curb extensions at Farragut Ave & Regis Dr (Staten Island, school safety).
projects.source_says: The project added painted and concrete curb extensions at Farragut Avenue at Regis Drive, Farragut Avenue at Goethals Road North, and Jules Drive at Goethals Road North to improve visibility, shorten pedestrian crossings, and slow vehicular turns.

programs.title: DDOT Notices of Intent, Planning & Sustainability Division, Apr-Jul 2025 (intersection items)

projects.text: Install a new crosswalk and daylighting (25 ft parking restriction) at 8th St NW & Highland Ave NW.
projects.source_says: New Crosswalk and “Daylighting” at the intersection of 8th Street NW and Highland Avenue NW. | In addition to the sidewalk, DDOT plans to install a new crosswalk and “daylighting” improvements at the intersection of Highland Avenue, NW and 8th Street NW.

projects.text: Install new crosswalks and daylighting at 16th St SE & Frankford St SE (access to Moten Elementary).
projects.source_says: New Crosswalk and “Daylighting” at the intersection of 16th Street SE and Frankford St SE | In addition to the sidewalk, DDOT plans to install new crosswalks at the intersection, on the south side of 16th St SE and on the east side of Frankford St SE, to provide pedestrian access from the new sidewalks to Moten Elementary School.

projects.text: Install a curb extension with sidewalk at 32nd Pl NW & Tennyson St NW.
projects.source_says: Installation of Curb Extension and Sidewalk at the intersection of 32nd Place NW and Tennyson Street, NW | DDOT’s Sidewalk Gap Program is proposing to install a new curb extension with sidewalk on the west side of 32nd Place, NW at the intersection of Tennyson Street, NW.

projects.text: Replace the quick-build curb extension with a permanent concrete curb extension and sidewalk at North Capitol St NE & Rock Creek Church Rd NE.
projects.source_says: Installation of Curb Extension and Sidewalk at the intersection of North Capitol Street NE and Rock Creek Church Rd NE | DDOT proposes installation of a new concrete curb extension that will permanently reconfigure the intersection.

projects.text: Install a new marked crosswalk and daylighting at Portal Dr NW & Roxanna Rd NW.
projects.source_says: Installation of New Crosswalk and “Daylighting” at the intersection of Portal Drive NW and Roxanna Road NW | As part of constructing a new sidewalk along the south side of Portal Drive NW, between Roxanna Road NW and 16th Street NW, DDOT’s Sidewalk Gap Program is planning to install a new marked crosswalk and “daylighting” improvements at the intersection of Portal Drive NW and Roxanna Road NW.
